content:
jade: midweek idea — tiny fantasy swap + 'buzzer-beater bean' pool during Thursday lunch? $1 entry, winner gets a jar of fancy spicy beans (yes it's a thing). :soccer: :fire: :beans:
marco: beans are an excellent motivator. what is a buzzer-beater bean? explain like i'm 5. :thinking_face:
tiffany: small pool where you predict which game will have a last-minute goal/shot in the final 2 mins. if correct, you get the beans. if multiple people correct, split jar or rock-paper-scissors.
gary: also proposing a fantasy swap mini: trade one player for a random office pick (names in a hat). keeps it chaotic and equal-opportunity. :hat2:
jade: quick rules draft:
```
- Buzzer-Bean Pool ($1): pick one pro game that will have a goal/field goal/3-pt in final 2 minutes. pay via Venmo to @jade-office, include slack handle.
- If multiple winners, decide by paper-rock-scissors or split jar.
- Fantasy Swap ($0 free): sign up to swap one fantasy starter. names drawn at noon, swap happens immediately.
- Loser-of-RPS buys lunch chips if split jar option chosen.
```
marco: spreadsheet: https://tiny.redwood/buzzer-beans (signups & venmo tracking). i'll set a tab for fantasy swap pairs.
tiffany: sign me up for both. also can we add a "prop bonus" where if your predicted game ends with a fluke (own goal / accidental tip) you get a sticker? :label: tiny flex.
gary: stickers are key. i'm in. also recommend we allow one late pick until kickoff but +$0.50 penalty to the prize (funds to office snack stash).
ops-bot: Poll created: "Allow late picks until kickoff for +$0.50 penalty?" Options: 👍 Yes, 👎 No. Expires in 18h.
jade: calendar-bot, please put a reminder for signups at 11:45am Thursday.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Buzzer-Bean Pool + Fantasy Swap" Thu 12:00pm. Reminder set for 11:45am.
marco: logistics: where do we convene for RPS tiebreaks? lobby or vending area? lobby has better acoustics.
tiffany: lobby works. also propose a short live bracket board for swap pairings — people love watching trades happen.
gary: question: can I opt out of the fantasy swap but still enter buzzer-bean?
jade: yes, both separate signups. mark the sheet accordingly.
marco: tiny flavor rule: if you predict a buzzer-beater AND your swapped player scores > 20 points that week, double-jar bonus (two jars or one jar + sticker). unrealistic but fun.
tiffany: double-jars are dangerous but very motivating. count me cautiously yes.
jade: final note: put your slack handle in Venmo and in the sheet, or you forfeit prize (we have had phantom payments before). see you Thursday — may the crispiest bean win. :crossed_fingers:
